Higgsfield AI is the fastest-scaling generative AI company in history, hitting $700M in annual revenue run rate, 30M+ users worldwide, 6M+ generations per day, and powering 390 of Fortune 500 brands. 

We're building at the absolute frontier of AI-powered video creation and next-generation creative tools. Joining Higgsfield means becoming part of a high-impact team shaping the future of AI-native experiences, at a company that isn't just moving fast, but rewriting what fast looks like.

About the role:

We’re looking for a Forward Deployed Creative Lead to sit at the intersection of generative AI, cinematic production, and enterprise customers.

You’ll turn customer briefs into exceptional demos and pilots, build production-ready AI workflows, and work directly with creative teams to bring Higgsfield into real-world production.

The creative bar is extremely high. You understand why a shot works — from lensing, lighting, and composition to camera movement, pacing, and edit rhythm — and know how to reliably achieve commercial-quality results with generative models.

What you'll do:

Own the technical and creative execution of enterprise demos, pilots, and deployments from brief through final delivery.

Direct and produce cinematic AI content, including shot design, generation, consistency, editing, and delivery.

Build repeatable production workflows using generative models, prompting systems, APIs, MCP, automation, and agentic workflows.

Reverse-engineer reference ads, film looks, and visual styles into reproducible Higgsfield workflows.

Lead live demos, workshops, and hands-on training for customer creative teams.

Partner directly with CMOs, creative directors, production leaders, and technical stakeholders.

Bring customer insights, product gaps, and emerging use cases back to Product, Engineering, and Research.

Stay at the forefront of image and video generation and continuously push what’s possible with Higgsfield.

Requirements:

Exceptional portfolio of cinematic AI work at commercial quality — portfolio first.

5+ years of experience in film, advertising, commercial, or creative production, including 2+ years hands-on with generative AI.

Deep fluency across image and video models, consistency techniques, VFX, motion, and AI production workflows.

Strong cinematic fundamentals across shot design, lighting, composition, storyboarding, camera movement, and editing.

Experience delivering customer-facing pilots, PoCs, or productions from brief through final output.

Comfortable presenting to executives and running live demos.

Ability to translate complex AI workflows for non-technical creative teams.

High agency, strong ownership, and the ability to move quickly in a startup environment.

Excellent communication skills.

Compensation & Benefits:

jobs.title: Junior Bioprocess Engineer
jobs.description:
**Junior Bioprocess Engineer**
==============================

We're working on a challenging and incredibly exciting mission: to bring cultured meat to market. Scaling up our cell culture processes plays a crucial part in achieving this mission.

We are currently looking for a **Junior Bioprocess Engineer** to join our **Bioprocess Development** team. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in bioprocess or chemical engineering and a hands-on, curious mindset.

Full-time · Maastricht

**Do you want the same as we do?**

Would you like to be a crucial part of bringing cultured meat to market, having a massive positive impact on the planet from an environmental and animal welfare perspective?

Do you love to collaborate with an international team of scientists and engineers in a fast-paced scale-up environment?

Are you excited to leverage your bioprocessing knowledge to operate and optimise bioreactor cultures for cell-cultivated meat?

**What is the purpose of your role?**

As a Junior Bioprocess Engineer, you will support the development, optimisation, and scaling of bioreactor processes for cell-cultivated meat production. You will work closely with engineers and scientists to execute experimental runs, analyse process data, and contribute directly to the scale-up of sustainable biomanufacturing technology.

**Your key responsibilities**

Support the operation, monitoring, and troubleshooting of bench-scale and pilot-scale bioreactors and other bioprocess equipment.

Execute and analyse experimental runs to optimise bioprocess parameters (such as dissolved oxygen, pH, mixing, and nutrient feed).

Perform routine maintenance, calibration, and cleaning/sterilisation of bioprocess equipment.

Participate in the short-term production phase based on Novel Food application requirements and timeline.

Maintain accurate technical documentation, SOPs, and data logs to support continuous process improvement and technology transfer.

Contribute to a safe, clean, and well-organised laboratory.

**Our ideal future team member**

BSc or MSc degree in Bioprocess Engineering, Biotechnology, Chemical Engineering, or a closely related field.

Hands-on experience with bioreactor operation (bench-scale or pilot scale) obtained through study projects, internships, or entry-level industry experience.

Solid understanding of bioprocess fundamentals, mass transfer, cell culture kinetics, and scale-up principles.

Analytical and problem-solving skills, with proficiency in data analysis.

Fluent verbal and written communication skills in English.

Willingness to work during weekends based on the weekend work rota in your project.

* ***Please be aware that we will only consider EU citizens for this position. This is only due to specific visa sponsorship requirements in the Netherlands for applicants coming from outside the EU. Feel free to apply if you think this might not be applicable to you.***

**What we have for you!**

We are a small team working on an innovation that we believe will have a huge global impact. As part of this exciting project, we promise that you will get to:

* Enjoy an enterprising work culture with lots of freedom in your projects.
* Combine science with a commercial goal.
* Enjoy 25 days of paid leave per year.
* The possibility of a 38h/week full-time schedule in order to create 13 extra (ADV) days in the year.
* Have access to fundamental trainings and be part of our continuous learning culture.
* Work in the beautiful, historical city of Maastricht.
* Enjoy flexible working hours.
* As part of competitive remuneration, receive a bonus plan similar to stock options called Stock Appreciation Rights (SARs).

  

We really look forward to hearing about you. Please note that you have until December 11th to apply for the position. We usually take up to 2 weeks to review the candidates following the closing date.

If you have any questions please reach out to our Head of Bioprocess Development, Niusha Nikravesh at niusha@mosameat.com.

* ***Please be aware that emails coming from our automated Homerun system could occasionally end up in spam/junk mail filters!***

==============================

We are working on a challenging and exceptionally exciting mission: to bring cultured meat to the market. Scaling up our cell culture bioprocesses plays a pivotal role in realising this goal.

We are currently seeking a highly experienced **Senior Bioprocess Engineer** to join our **Bioprocess Development** team. This is a hands-on technical role that requires extensive professional experience to execute and guide scale-up tasks, drive perfusion and harvesting operations, and maintain technical alignment with external CMOs.

Full-time · Maastricht

Would you like to play a pivotal role in bringing cultured meat to market, driving a major positive impact on environmental sustainability and animal welfare?

Are you eager to collaborate with a dynamic, international team of scientists and engineers in a fast-paced scale-up environment?

Are you excited to leverage your extensive hands-on bioprocessing expertise to drive bioreactor operations, TFF/ATF perfusion setups, and large-scale harvesting workflows?

**The purpose of your role**

As a Senior Bioprocess Engineer, you will focus on hands-on execution, scale-up, and technical transfer of bioreactor and downstream separation processes for cultivated meat production. In this role, you will bring deep technical expertise to operate pilot and large-scale bioprocess equipment, execute continuous TFF/ATF perfusion strategies, optimise cell recovery systems, and work in direct technical collaboration with external CMOs to enable commercial-scale manufacturing.

**Your key responsibilities**

Perform hands-on operation, monitoring, scale-up, and troubleshooting across bench-scale, pilot-scale, and commercial-scale stainless steel and single-use bioreactor systems.

Hands-on execution of bioprocess scale-up and harvesting strategies utilising Tangential Flow Filtration (TFF) and Alternating Tangential Flow (ATF) perfusion technologies.

Operate and optimize large-scale continuous and batch cell separation technologies.

Drive technical transfer and maintain hands-on technical collaboration with external CMO partners during scale-up campaigns.

Execute upstream processing activities, including seed train expansion, mammalian cell culture development, media optimisation, and feed strategy evaluation.

Conduct detailed process characterization and scale-down modeling to evaluate critical process parameters (CPPs).

Demonstrated strong organisational skills in project planning, meeting deadlines, executing work, and preparing high-level reports, as well as training other BPD team members in scale-up operations.

Maintain high standard technical documentation, SOPs, and process logs.

**Our ideal future team member**

M.Sc. or Ph.D. (preferred) in Bioprocess Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Biotechnology, or a related discipline alongside extensive professional industry experience.

Extensive professional industry experience in hands-on bioprocess scale-up, bioreactor operation, and technical transfer to pilot and commercial scales.

Deep, hands-on expertise with TFF/ATF perfusion systems, large-scale centrifugation and process characterisation.

Demonstrated technical collaboration with external CMOs, CROs, or technology vendors.

Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.

Flexibility to work weekend shifts according to project rota requirements.

Project teams in our Energy & Industrial Group (EIG) support industry-leading projects in power generation, water treatment, plant design, environmental compliance, mid/downstream oil & gas, and multi-disciplined industrial projects. We’re leading efforts to decarbonize the industry by utilizing advanced technologies in renewable energy, carbon capture, and hydrogen power. Our EIG teams perform detailed engineering services for large thermal projects, water desalination projects, and cogeneration projects; all of which often include the integration of photovoltaic (PV) solar and energy storage. We’re the industry leader in carbon capture technologies with experience executing pilot-scale to commercial-scale projects for utilities, industrial plants, and direct air capture. We provide engineering services for green hydrogen production via electrolysis using solar, wind, hydro, and nuclear power sources and we support on-site usage in power generation, fuel cells, and fueling stations.

Your responsibilities will include, but are not limited to:

* You will be responsible for leading the Mechanical Engineering design efforts for a team of junior and senior engineers and designers.
* You will work on challenging assignments that include investigating, troubleshooting, and solving a wide variety of mechanical engineering issues.
* Act as the Mechanical team lead in the coordination of detailed design phases for all aspects of mechanical engineering work.
* Develop integrated systems designs and perform supporting calculations for the planned work.
* Prepare technical specifications for mechanical engineering equipment.
* Prepare engineering studies.
* Perform independent reviews of work performed by others including calculations and drawing preparation.
* Coordinate and provide guidance to other engineers, project managers, client personnel, and suppliers to ensure a complete and timely design.
* Perform reviews of existing facilities to propose upgrades and replacements, and present findings and recommendations to clients and peers.
* Develop your career via peer-learning through sharing of knowledge with other experienced engineers by way of S&L’s systems of process and associated “Communities of Practice.”
* Provide guidance as a mentor in the development of less experienced engineers.
* Communicate and interact with client staff. There is the potential for you to travel to client and vendor offices for design reviews and to plant site locations for construction coordination and field verification of designs.

Qualifications:

**This position will be located in the UAE – local candidates are preferred.**

Essential skills and experience:

* Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering program is required; Master's in Mechanical Engineering preferred.
* Ten or more years of experience in the design of mechanical engineering systems for non-commercial, heavy industrial plants (power plant - essential, oil & gas, or chemical - valued), with a focus on integrated, detailed system design for new plants, modifications, or replacements; Experience must include the selection of equipment, piping materials, control philosophy, and the preparation of supporting calculations and specifications.
* Ability to take a lead role in the completion of preliminary engineering studies that evaluate multiple solutions to address a given client’s problem or need.
* Sound technical judgement, technical writing skills, and experience with preparing high level bills of materials and needed equipment lists for estimating.
* Three or more years of experience in leading an engineering design team through all phases of capital projects or small to medium plant services projects.
* Technically knowledgeable of available equipment and proven pre-engineered systems to execute systems design.
* Able to create design schematics, such as flow diagrams and P&IDs, using computer design software.
* Experience with serving as firm/client liaison in a support role to project managers and directors.
* Experience in reviewing design drawings created by others.

Valued but not required skills and experience:

* Engineering consulting experience and strong client relationships with MENA/CIS clients.
* Proposal development experience a plus.
* Construction, commissioning, and start-up experience a plus.

Technology & Innovation:

Sargent & Lundy values the appropriate use of technology to improve how work gets done and deliver high-quality outcomes for our clients. Depending on the role, employees may use data, automation, artificial intelligence, and other digital tools to support research, analysis, engineering and design activities, workflow improvement, or other aspects of their work.
  
  
We value candidates who demonstrate an interest in learning and effectively using emerging technologies where relevant to their role. Employees remain accountable for their work and are expected to apply appropriate professional judgment and review when using technology-assisted tools.
  
  
Experience with AI, automation, programming, or similar technologies is valued where relevant but is not required unless specifically identified elsewhere in the job description.

Award-Winning Benefits:

Sargent & Lundy is one of the most experienced full-service architect-engineering firms in the world. Founded in 1891, the firm is a global leader in power and energy with expertise in grid modernization, renewable energy, energy storage, nuclear power, and fossil fuels. Sargent & Lundy delivers comprehensive project services—from consulting, design and implementation to construction management, commissioning and operations/maintenance—with an emphasis on quality and safety. jobs.title: Senior Mechanical Engineer
jobs.description:
Prototyping, testen en Design for Manufacturing van metaal en kunststof producten

Utrecht | Techniek | Voltijd | Op locatie

**Breng een nieuwe vorm van voortstuwing naar massaproductie**

Over ons

Wij zijn een Nederlandse Deep-Tech startup die een nieuwe generatie elektroaerodynamische (EAD/EHD) voortstuwingstechnologie ontwikkelt. Onze systemen gebruiken nauwkeurig aangestuurde ionen en hoogspanningselektronica om luchtstromen op te wekken en te regelen.

Na jarenlange ontwikkeling hebben we een unieke, gepatenteerde technologie in handen. Nu ontwikkelen we daarop producten voor meerdere industrieën, waaronder luchtvaart en ventilatiesystemen.

We werken in een vertrouwelijke ontwikkelfase, dus publiekelijk is er nog weinig over ons te vinden. In ons laboratorium in Utrecht werkt een klein team van zeer ervaren engineers.

We zoeken een senior mechanical engineer die onze technologie omzet in betrouwbare, betaalbare producten voor massaproductie.

Jouw rol

Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de mechanische productontwikkeling: prototypen, testen, onderzoek en materiaalkennis, tot een werkend prototype dat klaar is voor industrialisatie. In 2027 ligt de focus vooral op het testen en valideren van prototypes. Je werkt nauw samen met onze test engineer, het EAD/EHD-, elektronica- en firmwareteam en twee C-level directeuren.

Eén van hen heeft jarenlange ervaring met complexe productontwikkeling en massaproductie in het Verre Oosten.

Je komt in een productontwikkelingsteam dat we de komende jaren verder uitbreiden. We zoeken geen managers, maar actieve, hands-on mensen die goed in een team passen en samen met collega’s producten bouwen.

**Prototypen is van levensbelang in deze rol.** Voordat we industrialiseren, wordt er intensief geprototyped en getest. Daarna breng je het ontwerp via Design for Manufacturing (DFM) naar productie.

Wat ga je doen?

* Kunststof producten ontwerpen in 3D CAD rond onze gepatenteerde EAD-technologie.

* Snel en veel prototypen, onder andere met 3D-printen op onze Bambu Lab-printers.

* Prototypes testen en valideren met de test engineer, en resultaten vertalen naar ontwerpverbeteringen.

* Onderzoek doen naar materialen en materiaaleigenschappen.

* Ontwerpen van prototype naar DFM brengen, klaar voor spuitgieten en industrialisatie.

* Toleranties bepalen voor spuitgietproducten en maakbaarheid.

* Soft tools, matrijzen, tooling en leveranciers in het Verre Oosten (China) beoordelen en aansturen.

* Producten ontwikkelen tegen een scherpe kostprijs en met hoge kwaliteit.

* Technische tekeningen, stuklijsten (BOM) en specificaties opstellen.

* De overstap van SolidWorks naar Onshape mee vormgeven.

Wat zoeken wij?

* Minimaal hbo in werktuigbouwkunde, industrieel productontwerpen, mechatronica of vergelijkbaar.

* Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring als mechanical engineer of productontwikkelaar.

* Aantoonbare ervaring met prototypen, testen en Design for Manufacturing.

* Ruime ervaring met 3D CAD in SolidWorks, en de motivatie om Onshape te leren, ons CAD-platform voor de toekomst.

* Zelf technische tekeningen gemaakt, en begrip van wat toleranties doen, vooral bij spuitgieten.

* Goede kennis van kunststoffen en materiaaleigenschappen in relatie tot maakbaarheid.

* Begrip van CNC-bewerking en ervaring met 3D-printen.

* Ervaring met soft tools, matrijzen en leveranciers in China of elders in het Verre Oosten.

* Projecten die je kunt laten zien en waaraan je zelf hebt gewerkt.

* Een hands-on teamspeler die graag met collega’s samenwerkt.

* Goed Engels in woord en geschrift. Nederlands is een pre.

* Beschikbaar om voltijds in Utrecht te werken.

Ervaring die extra waardevol is

* Werken met Onshape.

* Producten voor luchtvaart of ventilatie.

* Ontwerpen rond elektronica en hoogspanning.

* Matrijsontwerp en kostprijsoptimalisatie.

* Werken binnen een startup.

Je hoeft niet aan alle genoemde eisen te voldoen. We zijn vooral geïnteresseerd in mensen die producten echt naar massaproductie hebben gebracht en die de motivatie hebben om iets volledig nieuws te bouwen.

Wie ben jij?

Je bent een ervaren productontwikkelaar die weet wat ervoor nodig is om een idee in grote aantallen te laten produceren. Je hebt de weg van prototype naar massaproductie al vaker afgelegd, kent de valkuilen en weet hoe je ze voorkomt.

Je denkt in maakbaarheid, kosten en kwaliteit, en bent nieuwsgierig naar nieuwe technologie. Je neemt eigenaarschap en geeft richting zonder manager te hoeven zijn.

Waarom werken binnen ons bedrijf?

Bij ons ontwikkel je de eerste producten op basis van een potentieel baanbrekende, gepatenteerde voortstuwingstechnologie.

* Werk aan echte producten op basis van bewezen technologie.

* Bepaal mee hoe onze producten eruitzien en gemaakt worden.

* Werk direct samen met de uitvinders en ervaren directeuren.

* Heb een eigen test engineer en een volledig uitgerust lab tot je beschikking.

* Zet de ontwikkel- en productiestandaarden neer voor een nieuw technologieplatform.

* Word onderdeel van een klein, ambitieus team waarin jouw bijdrage verschil maakt.

Omdat we in een vertrouwelijke ontwikkelfase opereren, kunnen we nog niet alle technische details openbaar maken. Tijdens de sollicitatieprocedure vertellen we zoveel als de vertrouwelijkheid toelaat, zodat je een duidelijk beeld krijgt van de producten, de technische uitdagingen en de werkomgeving.

Praktische informatie

* **Locatie:** Utrecht

* **Dienstverband:** Voltijd

* **Werkwijze:** Voornamelijk op locatie in ons kantoor en laboratorium

* **Startdatum:** In overleg

Kandidaten moeten al gerechtigd zijn om in Nederland te werken, of deze werkvergunning kunnen verkrijgen.

**Interesse?** Stuur je cv of LinkedIn-profiel en vertel kort welk product jij van prototype naar productie hebt gebracht. Een portfolio met je 3D CAD-werk en gerealiseerde producten is van harte welkom!

Salaris: €5.000,00 - €7.000,00 per maand

Arbeidsvoorwaarden:

* Kosteloos parkeren
* Mogelijkheid tot promotie
* Reiskoste

**What if your next playground was to build a global, iconic Brand, with a creative machine that never sleeps, and compounds?**

Then you’ll love this.

We’re not looking for a "Social Media Manager" to follow a calendar. We’re looking for an AI-native Creative Director (Brand & Content).

Someone who understands that to win today, you don’t just need "content", you need a Movement.

**This isn’t another content job.** Most content teams use AI to write captions faster. That’s the 99%. We want to be in the 0.1%: a media where AI runs the creative loop, from the signal to the hook, the cut, the post and the lesson. Every day, on every platform, in French and in English. You bring the taste. The machine you build brings the scale.

Here’s the bet: a company that learns by itself grows in a way a company of people alone can’t. We aim for $10M in revenue with 10 people, each of them running a dozen agents.

**WHAT AI-NATIVE CONTENT MEANS AT PARADOX**
-------------------------------------------

Paradoxically, the more AI runs our content, the more human it has to feel. AI doesn’t make more of what everyone makes. It makes more of what only we can make.

Our creative machine has to be able to:

**1. Read the signals.** Comments, DMs, retention graphs, saves, shares, search trends, objections from sales calls, and what the best creators and advertisers in the world are publishing right now.

**2. Hold the full context of Paradox.** Our DNA, years of interviews, lives and courses, member stories, and every past post with what it taught us, in one shared company brain.

**3. Generate in our voice.** Hooks, scripts, shorts, carousels, cuts, thumbnails and captions, in French and in English.

**4. Ship.** Format, schedule, publish and answer, on every platform.

**5. Measure with real KPIs.** Retention, shares, saves, follower growth, and the followers who become leads and members. Not likes.

**6. Learn and loop on its own.** Double down on what works, kill what doesn’t, write the lesson back into the brain, and start the next cycle without waiting for a meeting.

This is already real. An ads library of thousands of creatives feeds our creative research. Agents cut ads from long-form content and wire Instagram comment-to-DM automations. And our product is AI-native too: Athena, our AI coach, works with members every day.

**OUR MISSION**
---------------

At Paradox, we are convinced that greatness is trainable, and we believe self-help is broken.

Most learning platforms are used the same way: consuming generic theories, getting quick highs, ending with no real change.

People deserve more: a system that knows them, one that adapts, challenges, and grows with them.

That’s why we want to empower people at scale, by leveraging cutting edge technologies like AI, and crafting user experiences with outstanding aesthetics.

We do that by merging:

* Human Intelligence (coaches, peers, and mentors)
* Structured Intelligence (protocols, mental models, rituals)
* Technological Intelligence (AI personalization, feedback loops, adaptive journeys)

To create one seamless ecosystem: Paradox OS.

**Short history**

Paradox was founded by David Laroche, a creator followed by over 2 million people and known for his interviews with icons like Tony Parker, Mike Horn, Richard Branson and Gad Elmaleh. We started in French. We’re building for the world.

**YOUR MISSION**
----------------

You lead the Content Factory not by management, but with creativity.

Your goal is to produce content that is so good, unique, and aligned with our values that people would cry if they had to unsubscribe.

In a classic content team, people do the work and AI helps. Here it’s the other way round: agents do the volume, you design the machine, set the bar and make the calls. Humans do what no machine can: taste.

**YOUR 5 MAIN MISSIONS**
------------------------

### **1. Architect the "Dual-Brand" Strategy**

* Build a symbiotic strategy where David Laroche’s personal brand and Paradox’s company brand reinforce each other without cannibalization.
* Implement radical new formats (documentaries, conceptual shorts) that shatter the boring codes of the "Self-Help" industry.
* Define distinct, sharp editorial lines for each platform: Depth & Search for YouTube, Aesthetic & Vibe for Instagram, and Authority & Authenticity for LinkedIn.
* The old way: a strategy deck written once a year, and a calendar filled by habit.
* At Paradox: agents watch every platform, every competitor and every comment continuously. They tell you which angle is rising, which format is tiring and which story our audience asks for. The strategy updates every week, on evidence.

### **2. Radical Concepting & End-to-End Delivery**

* Take responsibility for the entire production chain from hooks to storyboarding the narrative, and ensuring the final cut matches the vision.
* Own the packaging: titles, thumbnails and the first 3 seconds. You test variants every week and know your click-through and retention numbers by heart.
* Deliver what you pitch.
* The old way: one shoot becomes one video and a handful of posts.
* At Paradox: one shoot, one live or one interview becomes dozens of hooks, shorts, carousels and ad cuts by the next morning, in both languages. Concepts are tested with AI-generated drafts before we spend a day shooting them.

### **3. Build the Content Factory: humans and agents**

We're not building another image generator. We're building a technology that understands why images matter — the emotion, meaning, composition, and creative decisions behind a photograph — so that millions of people can become part of extraordinary visual experiences.



This is not a traditional design role. This is a chance to help build the future of photography in the age of AI.



About The Project: Character Transfer

Unlike traditional face-swap technology, we're not just replacing one face with another.



We're building a system that understands the complete visual story of an image — why a moment feels special, what emotion it communicates, what makes the composition powerful, and what must stay unchanged for the image to keep its meaning.



The goal: when a new person enters an existing scene, it should feel as if they were truly there when the photograph was taken.



Not inserted. Not copied. Belonging.



Who We're Looking For

We need a rare combination of creative intelligence and technical curiosity — someone who sees beyond pixels and can read the emotional core, hidden story, and creative intention behind a photograph.



You may come from photography, filmmaking, advertising, fashion, VFX, digital production, or creative technology. Your background matters less than your ability to understand visual language.



Your Mission

You'll help build the intelligence behind our Character Transfer Engine, focused on three areas.



1. Teaching AI to Understand Visual Stories




Every photograph has creative DNA.
For each template, you'll define:
the story being told
its emotional purpose
the relationship between people and environment
visual hierarchy
what must be preserved
what can adapt


Example




A romantic image isn't just "two people looking at each other" — its true value is connection, anticipation, vulnerability, intimacy, trust.
A travel image isn't just "someone near a landmark" — it's discovery, freedom, adventure, achievement, memory.
AI has to understand that difference.


2. Designing Scalable AI Creative Systems

We're not looking for someone who manually perfects one beautiful image — anyone can do that.



We need people who can help build a system that delivers consistently excellent results across:

thousands of templates




millions of users
every age
every appearance
every body type
every culture
every photography condition


You'll contribute to:




AI workflow design
creative instructions
prompt architecture
transformation logic
quality standards
edge-case analysis
evaluation frameworks


3. Evaluating AI Results Through a Creative Lens

You'll help define what high quality really means by evaluating whether results preserve:




Identity — does the person still feel authentic?
Story — do they naturally belong in the scene?
Emotion — does their expression and body language match the moment?
Physical Reality — lighting, shadows, perspective, camera characteristics, skin texture, anatomy, natural imperfections
Artistic Value — does this look like a real moment that actually happened?


Ideal Background (One or More)

Photography & Visual Storytelling

Professional, commercial, or fashion photographers, photo editors, creative/art directors, cinematographers who understand composition, lighting, emotion, directing people, and visual communication.



Advertising, Fashion & Brand Creative

Experience with advertising campaigns, fashion or luxury brands, creative studios, or commercial productions.

You know great images don't just look beautiful — they communicate ideas.



VFX & Digital Production

Compositing, CGI, motion design, digital production pipelines.

Especially valuable: experience maintaining visual quality across large-scale production.



AI Creative Technology

AI image generation/editing workflows, multimodal AI systems, diffusion models, ComfyUI workflows, advanced prompting, creative automation.

Note: pure prompt-writing experience alone isn't enough — we need people who understand visual intelligence.



What Makes Someone Exceptional Here




The strongest candidates think in multiple dimensions at once.
A photographer asks: "Why does this image create emotion?"
A filmmaker asks: "What story is happening in this moment?"
An art director asks: "What should the audience feel?"
A technologist asks: "How can we make this repeatable at scale?"
The ideal person combines all four.


Who This Role Isn't For

This isn't for someone who only creates attractive AI images or experiments with prompts, or who optimizes a single result manually.



We're looking for people who understand creativity, build systems, and help AI learn the principles behind great photography.



Hiring Challenge

Candidates may be asked to analyze a collection of original photo templates and explain:




what makes each image emotionally powerful
the core story of the image
which elements must be preserved vs. adapted
how to design a system capable of maintaining quality across 500+ different people
The goal isn't one impressive image — it's designing the thinking behind thousands of successful ones.

A system that understands existing human creativity and lets anyone become part of meaningful visual stories.

We are an experienced team of industry experts dedicated to helping readers make smart decisions and choose the right products with ease. Forbes Advisor boasts decades of experience across dozens of geographies and teams, including Content, SEO, Business Intelligence, Finance, HR, Marketing, Production, Technology and Sales. The team brings rich industry knowledge to Forbes Advisor's global coverage of consumer credit, debt, health, home improvement, banking, investing, credit cards, small business, education, insurance, loans, real estate and travel.

Forbes Advisor is hiring an AI Creative Lead to own the generative stack that turns approved scripts and storyboards into finished, on-brand video and static ads. This person is two things at once: a creative with a deep understanding of direct-response marketing, and a hands-on operator who lives in the AI tools daily. You run the back half of our pipeline, from character-locked stills through AI video, lip-sync, and voiceover to editor-ready footage, and you treat every step as a creative call as much as a technical one: what serves the story, what sells, and what will read as a real ad in the feed.

The role reports into the Head of Creative Production and partners with our Creative Directors and Editor/Designers. You know what makes a DR ad work, the hook, the pacing, the proof, and the turn to the offer, and you know which model(s) to use and why. You can hold character, wardrobe, and continuity across a whole spot, debug a broken render instead of re-rolling, and get renders through touchy platform filters. You have shipped AI-generated video that ran as paid creative, and you can tell real-ad output from output that just reads as AI.

We are a human-led shop that uses AI to move faster without diluting craft. You protect the craft bar rather than lowering it to what the model makes easy, and you stay current with a stack that turns over frequently, treating every tool pick as a short-term decision.

Responsibilities



Own generation end-to-end for paid social and native creative: character-locked stills, AI video, lip-sync, and clean generated voiceover, from approved script and storyboard to editor-ready footage. Lock base characters first, then build a still per beat that references them, holding character, wardrobe, prop, and continuity consistency across an entire spot. Pick the right model for each job (hero vs. volume, native-audio vs. img-to-video) and keep a live view of a fast-moving tool stack, pinning exact model versions at build time. Scout, test, and onboard new models and tools as the stack evolves, and retire the ones that fall behind, so the team is always working with the best available. Get renders through platform and category filters. Diagnose and auto-fix a broken render once, then escalate, and keep a running swipe of safe phrasings and prompt patterns that pass. Operate and lightly orchestrate the tooling (fan-out, scheduling, asset movement) so many jobs run in parallel without a person babysitting each one. Own the generative-side handoff into post: deliver organized, tagged, editor-ready clips into the DAM to the production team's standards. Feed the shared learnings file (format, copy, render, and legal notes per job) and read it back at the next job's start so the system compounds instead of repeating mistakes. Partner with the Creative Directors and copywriters to keep generated output on-voice, on-persona, and matched beat-for-beat to the script (AV sync). Bring a direct-response creative eye to every job: push each render toward what sells, the hook, the pacing, the proof, and the turn to the offer, not just what looks good. Operate inside compliance rails for our regulated categories: no better-drug or results claims, coverage/qualify framing, required disclosures, and honest routing. Hold generation to the same gate as the rest of the pipeline. Manage generative tooling spend against render volume, and give the Head of Creative Production a real monthly cost model as volume scales. Build reusable assets (prompt libraries, character references, templates, and workflow docs) that let editors and strategists self-serve the routine work. 

Requirements

4+ years in creative production, motion, VFX, or content, with at least the last 1 to 2 years hands-on in generative AI video and image production for real deliverables. A real grounding in direct-response creative. You understand how a DR ad is built (hook, problem, mechanism, proof, offer, and CTA) and can judge whether a cut will convert, not only whether it looks polished. Demonstrated generative craft: a reel or portfolio of AI-generated or AI-assisted video and stills, with an honest account of what you made vs. what the model made, and (ideally) how it performed. Deep, current fluency with the generative stack: multi-subject-consistency image models, AI video (native-audio and img-to-video), lip-sync, and AI voiceover. You have opinions on trade-offs, not just tool names. Character and continuity discipline: you can hold a consistent character across many shots and beats, not just generate one good frame. Prompt and troubleshooting fluency: you can diagnose why a render broke or a character drifted and fix it deliberately, rather than re-rolling until something lands. Comfort building light automation/orchestration around the tools (e.g. n8n, Gumloop, or comparable) to fan out and move assets. You don't need to be an engineer, but you're not afraid of the glue. A finishing eye: you know when AI output reads as a real ad vs. a tech demo, and you hold the line on craft. Demonstrated speed and volume in a performance, DR, or high-output content environment. Daarbij maken we gebruik van vrijwel alle gangbare eenheidsbewerkingen die binnen de procesindustrie worden toegepast, wat zorgt voor een veelzijdige en technisch uitdagende werkomgeving.

Wil jij werken in een internationale organisatie waar samenwerking, innovatie en continue verbetering centraal staan? Dan komen wij graag met je in contact.

Voor onze locatie in Zwijndrecht zijn wij op zoek naar een

  

**Process Engineer**

  

In deze fulltime functie maak je deel uit van het Process Engineering Team en werk je nauw samen met collega's binnen Nederland en onze internationale organisatie. Je rapporteert aan de Process Engineering Manager.

**De taken en verantwoordelijkheden van deze functie omvatten onder meer:**

* Analyseren en oplossen van procesverstoringen en terugkerende productieproblemen, in nauwe samenwerking met Operations, Maintenance, EHS, Quality en Process Control.
* Uitvoeren en beoordelen van procesberekeningen, waaronder massa- en energiebalansen, en interpreteren van proces-, productie- en ontwerpgegevens.
* Initiëren en technisch uitwerken van verbeteringen op het gebied van veiligheid, kwaliteit, capaciteit, betrouwbaarheid, energie-efficiëntie en kosten.
* Leveren van procesengineeringinput bij projecten, vanaf probleemidentificatie, probleemdefinitie en conceptontwikkeling tot implementatie, commissioning en overdracht aan Operations.
* Bijdragen aan procesveiligheidsstudies en risicobeoordelingen, waaronder PHA-LOPA/HAZOP studies, en opvolgen van daaruit voortkomende technische acties.
* Beoordelen en begeleiden van proceswijzigingen via het Management of Change (MOC) proces en borgen dat relevante procesdocumentatie actueel blijft.
* Analyseren van proces- en productiegegevens, herkennen van trends en afwijkingen en vertalen van bevindingen naar structurele verbetermaatregelen.
* Samenwerken met process-control- en automatiseringsspecialisten bij vraagstukken rond procesinstrumentatie, regeltechniek en DeltaV.
* Deelnemen aan de consignatiedienst: gedurende één week 24/7 bereikbaar zijn en binnen één uur op locatie kunnen zijn. De dienst vindt ongeveer één keer per vijf weken plaats.
* Een actieve bijdrage leveren aan de doelstellingen van Ashland door initiatief te nemen, resultaten te realiseren en veiligheid centraal te stellen.
Bijdragen aan de verdere ontwikkeling van de organisatie door sterke samenwerkingen op te bouwen, talent optimaal te benutten en effectief te communiceren.  

**Wat deze functie niet is:**

* De Process Engineer is niet de eigenaar van ieder technisch probleem in de plant, de functie richt zich op en is medeverantwoordelijk voor proces-technische analyse en ondersteuning wanneer proceskennis en engineeringexpertise nodig zijn.
* De functie is geen pure projectfunctie. Naast projectondersteuning ligt een belangrijk deel van de toegevoegde waarde bij troubleshooting, procesveiligheid, optimalisatie, capaciteitsverbetering, energie-efficiëntie en het structureel verbeteren van de technische prestaties van het productieproces.
De functie is niet uitsluitend kantoorgericht. Regelmatige aanwezigheid in de productieomgeving en nauwe samenwerking met de plantorganisatie zijn essentieel.  

**Om succesvol te zijn in deze functie beschik je over:**

* Een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding Chemische Technologie, Chemical Engineering of een aantoonbaar gelijkwaardige technische opleiding.
* Minimaal 2 tot 5 jaar ervaring met procesengineering binnen de chemische industrie of een vergelijkbare procesindustriële omgeving.
* Ervaring met PHA-LOPA/HAZOP studies en het Management of Change-proces.
* Ervaring met procesberekeningen, massa- en energiebalansen, productieondersteuning, troubleshooting en procesoptimalisatie.
* Ervaring met en kennis van procesveiligheid, risicoanalyse en Management of Change.
* Uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk.
* Goede beheersing van het Nederlands en Engels, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk.
* Bereidheid en praktische mogelijkheid om consignatiediensten te lopen en binnen één uur op locatie in Zwijndrecht te zijn.
* Verantwoordelijk en ethisch gedrag te allen tijde
Het vermogen om het bedrijf te helpen meer waarde te creëren door inzicht in de bedrijfsvoering, het nemen van complexe beslissingen en het bedenken van nieuwe en vernieuwende oplossingen  

**Bij voorkeur beschik je over:**

* Ervaring met commissioning, start-ups en shutdowns.
* Ervaring met het DeltaV-besturingssysteem.
* Ervaring met data-analyse en process-historiansoftware.
Ervaring met investeringsprojecten, debottlenecking of continuous-improvementprojecten.  

**De voordelen van werken bij Ashland:**

* Vergoeding voor consignatiediensten.

Voor meer informatie over de vacature neem je contact op met Rudolf van Veelen, Process Engineering Manager op telefoonnummer +31 786 251 275 of via e-mail rvanveelen@ashland.com.

----------------------

In this role, you will work on something that does not yet exist: a completely new platform within our latest generation of Advanced Packaging machines. This is no development on an existing machine, but true pioneering. If you are passionate about turning complex mechanical concepts into reality and eager to make an impact, this position offers the perfect opportunity to apply your skills. You will work within a growing team where you can truly make impact. You will have the freedom to introduce and develop your own ideas, with ample opportunity for feedback and refinement from our team. All design work is done in NX and managed in Teamcenter. - Translate functional and system requirements into robust mechanical designs, ensuring performance, manufacturability, reliability, and cost-effectiveness. - Perform tolerance analyses and detailed dimensioning, taking into account precision, thermal behaviour, and assembly constraints. - Conduct mechanical analyses and simulations (e.g. FEM, stiffness, deformation, eigenfrequencies, thermal effects) to validate design performance. - Collaborate closely with system engineers, mechatronics engineers, suppliers, and international teams (including Singapore and Hong Kong) to ensure alignment with system-level performance. - Contribute to the definition and realization of mechanical subsystem concepts, including prototype design and implementation. - Support integration and testing of prototypes and modules, perform root cause analysis, and implement design improvements. - Participate in design reviews and technical discussions, ensuring compliance with performance, quality, safety, and cleanroom (e.g. ISO 3) requirements. - Work with suppliers and manufacturing teams to ensure design for manufacturability and assembly (DfM/DfA) and support industrialization. - Maintain structured technical documentation (drawings, specifications, change management) and contribute to continuous improvement and innovation, including support in patentable concepts where relevant.

jobs.title: Mechanical Engineer
jobs.description:
**Mechanical Engineer**

**Wat ga je doen?**

Engineer ben je technisch verantwoordelijk voor het bedenken, uitwerken en vastleggen van 3D-ontwerpen, samenstellingen en opstellingstekeningen voor onze robotcellen. Je werkt aan R&D én aan klantprojecten, vertaalt klanteisen naar maakbare ontwerpen en zorgt voor een soepele overdracht naar productie en service. Voor onze klantprojecten configureer je de robotcellen grotendeels uit bestaande bouwblokken waarbij je regelmatig met klantspecifieke Engineer to Order features de puntjes op de i zet. In de R&D projecten werk je van definitie t/m realisatie samen met de andere engineeringsdisciplines aan nieuwe producten en features.

  

**Jouw belangrijkste taken:**
  
  
**Projectengineering:**

* Configureren van robotcellen uit beschikbare modules in 3D CAD (SolidWorks) en in ERP, afgestemd op klantspecificaties
* Maken van opstellingstekeningen van CNC‑machines met de robotcel
* Bedenken van klant specifieke features welke je af stemt met de klant, productie en service.

**R&D projecten:**

* Bedenken van concepten voor nieuwe producten en features op basis van specificaties, eisen en wensen. Dit doe je samen met de andere disciplines robot, electrical en software engineering
* Op basis van het beste concept ontwerpen van oplossingen in 3D CAD (SolidWorks) incl. bijbehorende technische berekeningen. Prototypen testen en bevindingen doorvoeren
* Uitwerken naar 2D‑tekeningen, afstemmen van maakbaarheid met werkplaats en leveranciers en borgen van data in ERP
* Ondersteunen van verkoop nog voor een robotcel verkocht is het bieden van klant specifieke oplossingen
* Continu verbeteren van producten via standaardisatie, modularisatie en kwaliteitsverhoging, o.b.v. eigen ideeën en feedback vanuit productie en service.
  

***Over BMO Automation***

*BMO Automation is sinds 2008 specialist in CNC*‑*automatisering en robotica. We ontwikkelen en bouwen slimme robotcellen voor de verspanende industrie, nationaal én internationaal. Innovatie, kwaliteit en teamwork staan centraal – én natuurlijk plezier en trots op wat we samen maken.*

*Je komt terecht in een enthousiast en gedreven team van drie Mechanical Engineers. Samen met je directe collega’s én de andere engineeringdisciplines werk je aan innovatieve robotoplossingen die wereldwijd worden ingezet.*

  

**Wat we jou bieden**

* **Salaris:** Uitstekend en afhankelijk van je ervaring
* **Contract:** jaarcontract met uitzicht op vast
* **Inwerktraject:** uitgebreid, met kennismaking met systemen, processen en collega’s

* **Team & cultuur:** enthousiast team met mix van jong talent en ervaren collega’s
* **Ontwikkeling:** volop ruimte voor groei en verdieping
* **Extra’s:** gratis sporten in eigen fitnessruimte, vers fruit, EPIQ‑feesten en teamuitjes.
  

**Wat we van jou verwachten**

* MBO+/HBO werk‑ en denkniveau
* Afgeronde opleiding in Mechanical Engineering/ werktuigbouwkunde
* Ervaring met 3D CAD, bij voorkeur SolidWorks; kennis van MS Office en ERP (bijv. MKG)
* Technisch inzicht, analytisch vermogen en kwaliteitsbewustzijn; je werkt accuraat en gestructureerd
* Modulair denken; je vangt graag varianten in slimme standaardoplossingen
* Sterke beheersing van de Nederlandse taal
* Goede kennis van Engels en/of Duits is een pré.
  

**Ben jij een echte BMO’er?**

Bij BMO geloven we dat onze mensen het verschil maken. Een echte BMO’er is bevlogen, integer, vindt plezier in het werk en gelooft in de kracht van samenwerking.

* **Bevlogen:** Jij hebt een passie voor techniek en streeft ernaar altijd het beste uit jezelf en je team te halen. Je bent proactief en zoekt continu naar manieren om onze processen en dienstverlening te verbeteren.

* **Samenwerken:** Je gelooft in de kracht van teamwork en ondersteunt je collega’s waar nodig. Je communiceert duidelijk en werkt samen aan gezamenlijke doelen.
  

**Onze cultuur**

Bij BMO heerst een open, informele cultuur waarin samenwerking en innovatie centraal staan. Jouw ideeën worden gewaardeerd en we stimuleren een proactieve houding. Samen werken we aan uitdagende projecten, behalen we successen en bieden we ruimte voor persoonlijke en professionele groei.

*Empowering People to Push Potential into Performance.*

Herken jij jezelf in onze kernwaarden en ben je klaar om het verschil te maken? Stuur dan je CV en motivatie naar career@bmo-online.com.

  

Wij kijken uit naar jouw sollicitatie!

Voor vragen over de procedure kun je contact opnemen met onze HR-afdeling: via career@bmo-online.com of +31 (0) 495 622 437.

Would you like to contribute to maintaining the infrastructure of tomorrow? From bridges and pumping stations to locks and flood defense systems. As a Maintenance Engineer, you ensure that our assets remain safe, reliable, and future-proof. You combine engineering expertise, data, and collaboration to develop smart maintenance solutions.
  

**THE POSITION**
----------------

As a Maintenance Engineer within Asset Management, you prepare maintenance activities for infrastructure assets in and around the water environment, analyse their technical condition, and continuously improve maintenance plans. You translate our clients’ maintenance requirements into practical and executable plans.
  
  
By assessing the technical condition of assets, you determine the maintenance activities required. You develop maintenance plans and cost analyses that support well-informed decision-making. Working closely with colleagues and other stakeholders, you help ensure that our infrastructure remains safe, reliable, and ready for the future.

**YOUR IMPACT**
---------------

You contribute to the maintenance of critical infrastructure assets, including bridges, pumping stations, and locks along the Lek, Maas, and Waal rivers, the Afsluitdijk, and assets located in the Dutch floodplains (*Uiterwaarden*). Using your technical expertise and analytical skills, you determine what maintenance activities are required and when they should be carried out.

  
  

You advise both internal and external stakeholders on the most effective maintenance approach. Your analyses enable teams to make well-founded decisions and organise maintenance activities efficiently. Together with your colleagues, you translate complex maintenance challenges into clear plans and tangible results. You will be responsible for:

* Analysing the technical condition of infrastructure assets and determining maintenance requirements;
* Developing and optimising maintenance plans based on client requirements and available data;
* Preparing cost analyses to support maintenance-related decision-making;
* Using maintenance management systems, such as Ultimo, to plan, manage, and monitor maintenance activities;
* Advising internal and external stakeholders on maintenance solutions and opportunities for process improvement.
  

  

### **YOUR WORKING ENVIRONMENT**

You will become part of a close-knit Maintenance team consisting of four colleagues. Together with the Tender Management, Project Management, and Process Management teams, you will be part of the Asset Management department. Through collaboration across different disciplines, you will share knowledge, learn from others, and contribute to a wide variety of infrastructure projects.

You will regularly work from our office in **Gorinchem**.

**ABOUT YOU**
-------------

You enjoy tackling technical challenges and approach your work in an analytical and structured way. You are able to translate complex information into clear recommendations and know how to engage different stakeholders in your proposals. You enjoy collaborating with colleagues, learning from others, and continuously looking for opportunities to improve maintenance practices and processes.

In addition, you bring:

* A completed MBO level 4 qualification combined with several years of relevant work experience, or a completed HBO (Bachelor's) degree;

jobs.title: Manufacturing Engineer
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about life sciences and engineering? Are you excited by the challenge of turning innovative biotech designs into reliable, scalable products? Do you thrive in a hands-on, problem-solving environment where you can drive continuous improvement, tackle complex technical challenges, and help shape the future of medical research and drug development?

If so, Optics11 Life is the place for you!

**Who we are**

Optics11 Life is a life sciences scale-up headquartered in Amsterdam, the Netherlands. We develop and manufacture the instruments researchers use to measure what cells sense, so they can make better-informed decisions in drug development. Over 300 instruments are in use worldwide, and our technology underpins more than 800 scientific publications.

**Purpose of this role**

As a Manufacturing Engineer, you are the technical link between R&D and production, solving challenges at their root to ensure our products can be manufactured reliably, efficiently, and at scale. You drive continuous improvement across assembly, testing, and supply chain processes, strengthening product quality, manufacturability, and long-term reliability while reducing operational and technology risks. As both a technical problem-solver and a driver of production excellence, you help turn innovative designs into robust, scalable products.

**Key activities**

* Identify and implement design improvements to enhance product manufacturability, reliability and serviceability.
* Lead structured root cause analyses and drive the implementation of lasting corrective and preventive actions.
* Resolve complex supply chain challenges by mitigating single-source and end-of-life component risks and qualifying alternative suppliers.
* Collaborate with R&D to integrate Design for Manufacturing and Assembly (DfM/DfA) principles into new and existing products.
* Lead technical troubleshooting and resolution of complex assembly and testing issues, acting as the first point of technical escalation across subassemblies, complete instruments and consumables.
* Create, update and maintain maintenance manuals and work instructions to support reliable product servicing.
* Define inspection and test requirements and develop production test plans and setups for incoming and intermediate inspections.
* Create and update maintenance manuals and step-by-step work instructions covering intermediate production stages, product inspection, maintenance, servicing and troubleshooting.

* MSc in Mechanical or Industrial Engineering, or a related field.
* 3–5 years of experience in manufacturing, production, or process engineering in a high-mix, low-volume environment.
* Extensive experience with common test equipment such as oscilloscopes, load cells, flatness tables, micrometers, and optical equipment.
* Knowledge of mechanical design and 3D CAD modelling, with a working understanding of electrical schematics.
* Hands-on attitude: comfortable on the production floor and at the test bench.

jobs.title: Maintenance Engineer
Maintenance Engineer
jobs.description:
**Introductie**
---------------

Bij TenneT werken we aan een energievoorziening die Nederland in beweging houdt. Als Maintenance Engineer maak jij direct impact op de toekomst van ons elektriciteitsnet. Jij speelt een sleutelrol in het beheer en onderhoud van onze kritieke locaties. Samen met je collega’s werk je aan duurzaam onderhoud van onze data- en controlcentra zodat we Nederland kunnen blijven voorzien van betrouwbare energie. Dankzij jouw inzet zorgen we voor een stabiel elektriciteitsnet van vandaag en morgen.

**Jouw rol**
------------

Als Maintenance Engineer ben jij mede verantwoordelijk voor het versterken en vernieuwen van het elektriciteitsnet, zodat Nederland kan blijven rekenen op betrouwbare en duurzame energie.

Je komt te werken in het team Maintenance binnen Real Estate and Facility Management, bestaande uit 17 gedreven collega’s. Samen werken jullie aan het beheer en onderhoud, asset management en modificaties van onze gebouwen, een essentiële taak voor een stabiele en duurzame energievoorziening. Binnen ons team heerst een open en professionele werksfeer, waarin samenwerking, kwaliteit en veiligheid centraal staan.

  
  

Jij draagt de regie en eindverantwoordelijkheid voor onze onderhoudsplanning en de succesvolle oplevering van het onderhoud. Je borgt een heldere verdeling van verantwoordelijkheden binnen het team en zorgt door dagelijkse aansturing van de technisch specialisten voor een effectieve en voorspelbare operationele uitvoering.

  
  

Je vertaalt assetstrategie en beleidskaders naar concrete onderhoudsopdrachten en stuurt onderhoudspartijen aan op resultaat. Je zorgt voor een heldere onderhoudsvraag en borgt een eenduidige werkwijze op de werkvloer..

Verder ben je onder andere ook verantwoordelijk voor:

* Inrichten, beheren en optimaliseren van onderhoudsplannen, taaklijsten en onderhoudsfrequenties;
* Regie voeren op de planning en beschikbaarheid van kritiek onderhoud;
* Aansturen van onderhoudspartijen en actief sturen op kwaliteit, kosten en prestaties;
* De afstemming met de technisch asset manager over MJOP, jaarplannen en onderhoudsstrategieën;
* Het zorgen voor een correcte en consistente registratie van de onderhoudsdata;
* Verbeteren van onderhoudsprocessen en deze doorvoeren richting leveranciers;
* Bewaken van samenwerking en bijsturen op resultaat op basis van input uit de operatie.

**Waar kom je terecht**
-----------------------

Real Estate & Facility Management (RE&FM) ontwikkelt, realiseert en beheert de fysieke werkomgeving van TenneT. Van kantoren en warehouses tot datacenters en control centers: RE&FM zorgt voor veilige, betrouwbare, duurzame en toekomstbestendige locaties. Met geïntegreerde vastgoed-, facility- en securitydiensten, professioneel assetmanagement en een sterke focus op gebruikerservaring ondersteunt RE&FM de primaire processen van TenneT en draagt zij bij aan de versnelling van de energietransitie. RE&FM maakt onderdeel uit van de divisie Digital & Technology Transformation (DTT), de digitale ruggengraat van TenneT.

**Jouw profiel & achtergrond**
------------------------------

Bij TenneT zoeken we professionals die bijdragen aan de toekomst van ons elektriciteitsnet. We verwachten dat je de juiste ervaring en vaardigheden hebt om een waardevolle bijdrage te leveren aan ons team en onze missie.

  
  

Wat breng jij mee?

* Besluitvaardig – je durft keuzes te maken, je neemt verantwoordelijkheid en je stelt scherp prioriteiten
* Communicatief sterk – je weet verschillende belangen te overbruggen
* Technisch inhoudelijk stevig – je kan inhoudelijk sparren en beoordelen, en vertaalt inhoud naar implementatie
* Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring in op het snijvlak van techniek, regie en opdrachtgeverschap, bij voorkeur in de industriesector of vergelijkbare hoog technische omgevingen.
* Diepgaande kennis van onderhoud- en onderhoudsprocessen en ervaring met het aansturen van externe partijen
* Een afgeronde HBO opleiding of HBO werk- en denkniveau bij voorkeur in de techniek
* Bereidheid om deel te nemen aan een tweedelijns 24/7 wacht- en storingsdienst voor storingen en incidenten.

**Arbeidsvoorwaarden**
----------------------

TenneT biedt jou de kans om bij te dragen aan een duurzame energietoekomst. Samen met collega’s, partners en stakeholders werk je aan innovatieve oplossingen die de energietransitie mogelijk maken. Bij ons krijg je de ruimte om je talent te ontwikkelen en werk je in een omgeving waarin jouw groei centraal staat. Wij stimuleren initiatief en geven je de ruimte om met nieuwe ideeën te komen.

  
  

Wij bieden jou:

* Een vast contract met twee maanden proeftijd, op basis van 40 uur per week.
* Een salaris in schaal 8: €4276,- tot €8443,-, met daar bovenop per maand 8% vakantiegeld en 6% eindejaarsuitkering.
* Een solide pensioen via ABP: wij betalen 70% van jouw premie.

Heb je vragen over de functie? Neem dan contact op met **Rutger Prins via Rutger.Prins@TenneT.eu**

About Al-Futtaim
  
Established in the 1930s, Al-Futtaim is one of the most diversified and progressive privately held regional businesses, headquartered in Dubai. Operating across more than 20 countries, the Group spans automotive, financial services, real estate, retail and health. jobs.title: Junior Quantum Design Engineer
jobs.description:
**About Us**
------------

QuantWare is building the world’s most powerful quantum processors to solve humanity's greatest challenges. We do this with our unique VIO technology, the only QPU architecture that breaks the hardware barriers that have held quantum computing back, unlocking the path to MegaQubit quantum processors.

With VIO, we are paving the way for the hyper-scale quantum computers that will change the world. And delivering on that vision demands people who don’t shy away from tackling the hardest challenges of our time. That’s where you come in!

As a **Junior** **Quantum Design Engineer**, you will take on a vital, hands-on responsibility in creating our next-generation quantum processors. Your core focus will be centred on the layout, simulation, and verification of quantum processor components and superconducting circuits. Collaborating directly with other design engineers alongside cross-functional R&D teams spanning fabrication, measurement, and system integration, you will transform conceptual device architectures into production-ready designs while closing the feedback loop between theoretical design intent and empirical performance. Your work will be essential as we scale to increasingly complex systems and deliver on the promise of quantum computing.

**What you'll be doing**

* Design and lay out superconducting circuit components and test structures, such as resonators, qubits, and control lines.
* Perform electromagnetic and circuit simulations to predict device parameters and optimise designs.
* Contribute to design verification, including design-rule checks and review of layouts against fabrication process constraints.
* Compare simulation results with measurement data to validate design models and feed learnings back into future design iterations.
* Help develop and maintain design tooling, automated layout scripts, and documentation to make our design flow faster and more robust.

**Your Profile**

* MSc in Physics, Applied Physics, Electrical Engineering, or a related field, ideally with a concentration in Quantum Computing or Quantum Technology (PhD is a plus).
* Understanding of microwave engineering, circuit theory, or superconducting devices, gained through coursework, a thesis project, or an internship.
* Experience with EM simulation tools (e.g. HFSS, Q3D, Sonnet) and layout tools (e.g. KLayout, Qiskit Metal).
* Python skills for design automation, simulation workflows, or data analysis.
* Detail-oriented mindset with a structured approach to design, verification, and documentation.
* Eagerness to learn, take ownership, and grow within a fast-moving, multidisciplinary team.
* Familiarity with superconducting qubits, circuit quantisation, or cleanroom fabrication processes is a plus.

jobs.title: IC Design Engineer
jobs.description:
**About the role**  
In this role you will be part of the Nexperia Business Group (BG) IC Solutions Logic development team, you will take ownership of the implementation of the technical requirements of products in logic families and switch families. You are expected to understand CMOS, IC design and analog IC design tools (Cadence or Synopsys).

**What you will do**

Your mission is to develop and release products, which are combinations of integrated circuits and plastic packages, produced and tested at high volumes at the lowest possible cost. These products meet all datasheet specifications, customer requirements, industry standards and quality requirements.

During the study, concept, design, validation and qualification phase of each project, you will contribute to a cross-functional team of design engineering, product engineering, test engineering and product quality engineer. You will drive chip design, specifications setting and verification while having the ownership of the top-level layout fit for all required packages.

As **design engineer**, you will make your key contributions to the design of cost-effective products by applying the most efficient way for the implementation of a set of designs within a logic family. You will develop master designs that can be configured into multiple derivative functions, sharing pin functionality and packages. You will implement customer requirements and make sure the product will meet datasheet values. You will do full top-level verification and specification setting agreement with the product manager.

**Besides this you will work on:**

* Design integrated circuits in 0.5um to 0.18um feature size CMOS and BCD wafer processes.
* Develop the products in a wide range of plastic packages.
* Design circuits with existing circuit techniques and optimize for area.
* Design, optimization and simulations on block level and top level of the IC using Synopsys/Cadence tools.
* Achieve First Time Right designs.
* Top-level functional simulations, full statistical verification of building blocks and datasheet parameters.
* Floor-planning, layout of blocks and top-level layout and wiring diagram creation.

**What you will need**
----------------------

* Master’s degree in electrical engineering
* Entry level experienced in circuit design and analog EDA tools and simulations techniques.
* Understanding of semiconductor device physics and device characteristics.
* Understanding of standard CMOS technology.
* Basic knowledge of ESD mechanisms and protection.
* Possesses Analytical Skills and ability to apply pragmatic approaches.
* Good communication skills in English, both written and spoken.
* Team player and target driven, shows initiative, has an entrepreneurial attitude and works independently.

**Why work for us?**
--------------------

* Flexible working hours and possibility of overtime reduction to maintain a Work-Life-Balance.
* Permanent employment contract with a competitive salary and supplementary voluntary employee benefits.
* Attractive Bonus.
* A wide variety of training courses and career development options.
* Numerous further benefits, such as retirement provisions, travel allowance, company events, sports and leisure activities, employee discounts and even more.

**About the team**
------------------

You will come to work in a larger team of IC Design Engineers and ESD experts as your direct colleagues, all closely working together in the Nijmegen location of Nexperia. jobs.title: Maintenance Engineer
jobs.description:
De Maintenance Engineer bij Equans werkt binnen de afdeling Asset Management en ondersteunt klanten in industrie en utiliteit met het optimaliseren van technische installaties. In deze rol analyseer je onderhoudsdata, prestaties en risico’s, en vertaal je inzichten naar onderhoudsstrategieën, onderhoudsplannen en verbetervoorstellen. Je voert storings-, risico- en root cause analyses uit, ondersteunt de inrichting van onderhoudsmanagementsystemen en adviseert klanten over onderhouds- en assetmanagementvraagstukken. Daarnaast werk je mee aan onderhoudscontracten, tenders, ontwerptrajecten en innovatieve oplossingen zoals asset performance management, risicogestuurd onderhoud, digitalisering, voorspellend onderhoud en data-analyse. De functie vraagt bij voorkeur minimaal 5 jaar ervaring in een vergelijkbare rol en ervaring met FMECA, RCA, onderhoudsprotocollen en Maintenance Management Informatiesystemen. Een hbo- of wo-opleiding in elektrotechniek, werktuigbouwkunde, technische bedrijfskunde of een aanverwante technische studie is gewenst. De rol biedt een vast contract, een salaris tot maximaal € 6100 bruto per maand op basis van 40 uur, 8% vakantiegeld, een winstdelingsregeling tot 10% en 38 vrije dagen per jaar.

**Description**
---------------

Wil jij impact maken met techniek én advies? Als Maintenance Engineer analyseer je prestaties, minimaliseer je risico’s en ontwikkel je slimme onderhoudsstrategieën die direct bijdragen aan de continuïteit en prestaties van technische installaties.

  

**Maintenance Engineer**

  

**Dit ga je doen**

Als Maintenance Engineer binnen Equans maak je deel uit van de afdeling Asset Management en help je klanten in de industrie en utiliteit om hun technische installaties optimaal te laten presteren. Je analyseert onderhouds- en assetmanagementvraagstukken en vertaalt data en inzichten naar slimme oplossingen die prestaties verbeteren, risico's verlagen en kosten beheersbaar houden. Je duikt in onderhoudsdata, storingen, prestaties en risico's om de betrouwbaarheid, beschikbaarheid en veiligheid van installaties te vergroten. Op basis van jouw analyses ontwikkel je onderhoudsstrategieën, voer je risico- en storingsanalyses uit en achterhaal je de oorzaken van terugkerende problemen. Deze inzichten zet je om in concrete verbetervoorstellen waarmee klanten hun onderhoudsorganisatie verder professionaliseren. Daarnaast stel je onderhoudsplannen op, optimaliseer je bestaande onderhoudsconcepten en ondersteun je bij de inrichting en doorontwikkeling van onderhoudsmanagementsystemen. Je helpt klanten om meer grip te krijgen op hun assets en ondersteunt hen bij het maken van onderbouwde keuzes voor de korte én lange termijn. Je bent een inhoudelijk sterke adviseur die makkelijk schakelt tussen techniek, operatie en management. Je werkt nauw samen met commercie- en contractmanagers en bezoekt regelmatig klanten en prospects. Tijdens deze gesprekken inventariseer je onderhoudsuitdagingen, presenteer je assetmanagement-oplossingen en laat je zien hoe een slimme onderhoudsaanpak bijdraagt aan hogere prestaties, lagere risico's en een langere levensduur van installaties. Daarmee speel je niet alleen een belangrijke rol in lopende projecten, maar draag je ook actief bij aan de verdere groei van onze assetmanagementdiensten.

  

Binnen Equans werk je aan een grote diversiteit aan projecten voor verschillende klanten, installaties en sectoren. Je ondersteunt opdrachtgevers bij het professionaliseren van hun onderhoudsorganisatie en levert een bijdrage aan onderhoudscontracten, ontwerptrajecten en tenders. Daarnaast denk je mee over innovatieve oplossingen op het gebied van Asset Performance Management, risicogestuurd onderhoud, digitalisering, voorspellend onderhoud en data-analyse. Deze functie biedt veel vrijheid, verantwoordelijkheid en afwisseling. Je krijgt de kans om kennis en expertise in te zetten bij uiteenlopende organisaties en levert direct een bijdrage aan veiligere, betrouwbaardere en toekomstbestendige assets.

  

**Jouw belangrijkste werkzaamheden op een rij:**

* Analyseren van onderhoudsdata, prestaties en risico’s om de betrouwbaarheid en beschikbaarheid van installaties te vergroten
* Ontwikkelen, optimaliseren en beheren van onderhoudsstrategieën, onderhoudsplannen en onderhoudsmanagementsystemen
* Uitvoeren van storings-, risico- en root cause analyses en deze vertalen naar concrete verbeteracties
* Adviseren van klanten over onderhouds- en assetmanagementvraagstukken en het verbeteren van onderhoudsprocessen
* Meewerken aan innovatieve projecten, onderhoudscontracten, tenders en de ontwikkeling van toekomstgerichte onderhoudsdiensten

**Dit bieden wij jou**

Natuurlijk begrijpen we dat voorwaarden belangrijk voor je zijn. Daarom bieden we je een aantrekkelijk arbeidsvoorwaardenpakket, waaronder:

* Salaris op basis van kennis en ervaring tot maximaal € 6100 bruto per maand, o.b.v. 40 uur
* Vakantiegeld 8 %
* Direct een contract voor onbepaalde tijd
* Een winstdelingsregeling tot 10 %
* 38 vrije dagen per jaar bij een fulltime dienstverband
* Goede pensioenregeling, waarbij Equans 2/3 van de premie betaalt (PMT)
* Een prettige werksfeer en fijne collega’s
* Een intern trainingsprogramma om je services skills te verruimen naar onze standaarden
* Veel doorgroei- en opleidingsmogelijkheden
* Vergoedingen voor overwerk, reisuren en consignatiediensten

**Waar ga je werken?**

Jij helpt – samen met zo’n 5.500 collega’s verdeeld over 32 locaties door heel het land – om de 3 grote transities van nu te versnellen: de energie-, digitale en industriële transitie. Dat doen we vanuit allerlei specialismen. Wat dat voor jou betekent? Volop mogelijkheden om je in allerlei richtingen te specialiseren of door te groeien. De afdeling asset management consultancy in Noord Nederland bestaat uit een team van 6 Maintenance & Reliability Engineers. Samen bedienen we klanten (zowel intern als extern) in de utiliteit en industrie. Het is een klein maar fijn team.
